750 fixed ORIGINAL CPython 3.13 Linux answers, captured before codec edits.
600 from premeasurement seed2122, 100 documents x PDF/legacySVG/mm/in/cm/pt12.
Six original non-string title-atom cases are independently frozen in
vector23_titles.txt (SHA256
b0e3be1f468939ef0d57a7a924f74abe8e296b679b24e3bbda69fdcfe0346f3f).
144 additional explicit adversarial cases: 14 numeric boundary datasets plus
empty-list/empty-stroke, each PDF plus 8 SVG units including Unicode suffixes,
uppercase/long names, 13/25/100/4096 decimals. Half-even RGB ties, no RGB clamp,
signed zeros, subnormals, f4 and 9g-boundary INPUTS (vector format stays fixed),
Latin1 PDF names/title and UTF8 SVG escaping, repeated/mixed layers, multisegment
and closed/open/empty paths. No rounding tolerances, normalized zeros or generated
native expectations. Captured original Python with every native hook disabled.

vector23_golden.txt SHA256:
83cee4db03dec50a35f767881c399a7e917ab6e5b68b6374fdd186e001cf7e6a
Line format, 16 pipe-separated fields:
format(0PDF/1SVG),stroke_count,segment_count,page_w/h floatbits,unit_scale bits,
digits,suffix UTF8 hex,title Latin1 hex,segment counts,closed flags,RGB bits,
width bits,Bezier xy bits,layer lengths,concatenated layer bytes hex,expected hex.
Float bits are lossless big-endian IEEE754 hex, comma-separated. Empty fields
are empty spans. Outputs include every byte, xref offset, newline and escape.

Original executable engines/generator are ONLY ignored local legacy backups.
Public tests need neither archives nor a Python codec/oracle. Existing 28 public
host/format checks retain fixed PDF/SVG digests and external-parser acceptance;
old private-builder comparisons transfer into these fixed Rust data tests.
New Python tests retain host/error/protocol/file-I/O ownership checks.
Existing 14 Rust stable-ABI tests stay intact; no old export was removed.

Compatibility/safety boundaries (intentional, no approximation):
- NaN/Inf/overflowed conversions, non-2D/four-point controls, nonpositive unit
  scales and resource excess refuse before opening any destination.
- Native missing/stale/protocol = RuntimeError; input/resource = ValueError.
- PDF text is Latin1 and retains UnicodeEncodeError and noniterable/nontext title
  TypeError instead of str coercion. Non-string title iterables retain original
  per-atom escaping (including multicharacter fragments), computed in Rust;
  vector23_titles.txt pins six additional independently captured exact cases.
  SVG metadata/suffixes are UTF8, unclamped RGB
  uses exact Python int(round(c*255)) half-even semantics on binary64 input.
  Arbitrary-precision SVG integer RGB is refused beyond +/-floor(2^53/255),
  rather than silently losing Python integer-product precision during marshalling.
- Precision is bounded 0..4096 rather than unbounded Python format allocation.
- Native encode/copy/free buffers remain transactional. The complete encoded
  result is validated before Python opens a destination. Invalid input/native
  failure therefore leaves an existing target untouched.
- File publication preserves original ordinary open(path, "wb")/write/close
  semantics: in-place truncation/write, existing inode/hardlinks/mode, symlink
  following, writable files in read-only parents, special files and supplied
  file descriptors. OS open/write/close errors propagate unchanged; no temporary
  files, replacement, synthetic directory errors, rollback or fsync guarantee.


This is Linux independent capture/proof, not a claim of a fresh actual Windows
MSVC/macOS run. Main owns platform qualification and packaged-native staging.
